notes: *the boughs* is taken as completing the verb's own denominative lexeme rather than as a supplied object; the competing reading marks it added (rule 44).

The unit heads on *go* rather than on *boughs*: rule 44's complement-heading cases are bleached light verbs (*give ear*, *made an end*), whereas *go over* carries the action itself. Heading on *boughs* by rule 44's subtraction test was the competing reading (rule 8).
אַחֲרֶיךָ is rendered by the single adverb *again*, so the suffix is unrepresented (rule 22); DEU.24.21 writes *after thee* for the same phrase and is aligned separately.
